name: kb
description: The knowledge base: the Hive's memory across projects and runs. Every journal event is filed under record/ on its own; agents search it with `hive agent search` (the module's own search program, search/: each file once, ranked by words, the entities that tie files together and the links between notes, with why each matched; `--deep "question"` sends a small research agent that digs and answers with sources), read it directly and write notes with `hive agent remember`; a scheduled filer consolidates new notes, and the module's dream program (dream/) works over the whole knowledge base and the record every few hours and at quiet moments: it merges duplicate notes into living notes, links related notes both ways, distils the record into project summaries and a practice note, retires notes later events contradict, and writes a digest of what the Hive learned under dreams/.
